name: Civil Procedure Code & Limitation
exam: AKNU Civil Procedure Code and Limitation Act exam
example: Section 11, and for splitting of claims Order II Rule 2

episodes.s: Sangram Singh — nature and history of civil procedure, features of the Code, definitions, jurisdiction Sec 9
episodes.cover: Inquisitorial vs adversary procedure; history from the Mayor's Courts and the 1859, 1877, 1882 and 1908 Codes; structure (158 sections vs 51 Orders), Sec 122-128 High Court and State amendments; principal features; Sec 2 definitions (decree, order, judgment, legal representative, mesne profits); Sec 9 suits of a civil nature, express and implied bars, Dhulabhai propositions, Kiran Singh, P.M.A. Metropolitan; kinds of jurisdiction and Sec 21

episodes.t: The Carrier Who Chose the Court
episodes.s: Patel Roadways — parties Order I, frame of suit Order II, place of suing Sec 15-21, summons Order V, discovery Order XI
episodes.cover: Order I joinder, necessary vs proper party (Kasturi), representative suit Rule 8, Rule 9-10; Order II Rule 2 splitting of claims (Gurbux Singh); Sec 26 institution; Sec 15-20 place of suing with the Sec 20 Explanation (Patel Roadways) and cause of action (A.B.C. Laminart); Sec 21-25 objections and transfer; Sec 27-29 summons and Order V modes, affixing, substituted service; Sec 30 and Order XI interrogatories, discovery, inspection

episodes.s: Daryao — res sub judice Sec 10, res judicata Sec 11 and its Explanations, foreign judgments Sec 13-14, 44A
episodes.cover: Sec 10 conditions and effect (Indian Bank v Maharashtra Co-op); Sec 11 six conditions, Explanations I-VIII, constructive res judicata (Nawab Hussain), Explanation VIII (Sulochana Amma), co-defendants, stages of the same suit (Satyadhyan Ghosal), writs and PIL (Daryao, Forward Construction), exceptions for fraud and jurisdiction; res judicata vs estoppel; Sec 12; Sec 13 six exceptions, Sec 14, Sec 44A reciprocating territories, Y. Narasimha Rao

episodes.s: Arivandandam — pleadings Order VI, plaint Order VII, written statement, set-off and counter-claim Order VIII, issues Order XIV
episodes.cover: Order VI Rule 2 material facts not evidence, Rule 4 particulars, Rule 6 condition precedent, Rule 13 presumptions, Rule 15 verification, Rule 16 striking out, Rule 17 amendment with the 2002 proviso (Revajeetu principles); Order VII Rule 1-8 contents, Rule 10 return, Rule 11 rejection (Arivandandam, Saleem Bhai, Dahiben), Rule 14 documents; Order VIII Rule 1 time (Kailash v Nanhku, SCG Contracts), Rule 5 deemed admission, Rule 6 set-off, Rule 6A counter-claim (Ramesh Chand Ardawatiya), Rule 10; Order XIV issues and preliminary issues

episodes.s: Salem Advocate Bar Association — Order IX appearance and ex parte, Order X, XII, XIII, XVI witnesses, Order XVIII hearing and affidavits, Order XVII adjournments
episodes.cover: Order IX Rules 6-13, sufficient cause (G.P. Srivastava, Parimal), concurrent remedies (Bhanu Kumar Jain); Order X Rule 1A Sec 89 reference (Afcons); Order XII Rule 6 judgment on admissions (Uttam Singh Duggal); Order XIII production; Order XVI list of witnesses and non-attendance; Order XVIII Rule 1-4 right to begin and affidavit evidence (Ameer Trading), Rule 17 recall; Order XIX affidavits; Order XVII Rule 1 three adjournments and provisos, Rules 2-3, arrears; Salem (I) and (II)

episodes.s: Dalpat Kumar — judgment and decree Order XX, injunctions Order XXXIX, receivers Order XL, attachment before judgment, costs, Sec 151, restitution Sec 144
episodes.cover: Sec 33 and Order XX Rules 1-6A, preliminary and final decrees (partition, Phoolchand, Venkata Reddy); Sec 94; Order XXXIX Rules 1-5 with the three tests (Dalpat Kumar, Gujarat Bottling, Morgan Stanley), Rule 3 proviso (Shiv Kumar Chadha), Rule 3A, Rule 2A disobedience; Order XL receivers (Krishnaswamy Chetty principles); Order XXXVIII arrest and attachment before judgment (Raman Tech); Sec 35, 35A, 35B costs; Sec 151 inherent powers (Padam Sen, Manohar Lal Chopra, Vinod Seth); Sec 144 restitution (South Eastern Coalfields)

episodes.s: Jolly George Varghese — execution Sec 36-74 and Order XXI: courts, modes, arrest, attachment, sale, objections
episodes.cover: Sec 36-46 courts which execute, transfer of decrees, precepts; Sec 47 questions in execution and the executing court not going behind the decree (Vasudev Dhanjibhai Modi); Sec 51 modes and the proviso on arrest (Jolly George Varghese); Order XXI Rules 10-23 application and notice; Rules 30-36 modes; Sec 55-59 and Rules 37-40 arrest; Sec 60 exemptions, Sec 64, Rules 41-57 attachment, garnishee, salary; Rule 58 claims; Sec 65 and Rules 64-96 sale, proclamation, deposit (Manilal Mohanlal Shah), Rules 89-92 setting aside; Rules 97-103 obstruction (Silverline Forum); Rahul S. Shah directions

episodes.s: Geeta Iron and Brass Works — suits against Government Sec 79-82 and Sec 80 notice, foreign States Sec 83-87B, public nuisance and charities Sec 91-93, interpleader, Sec 75-78, 94-95
episodes.cover: Sec 79; Sec 80 notice contents, purpose, 80(2) urgent leave, 80(3) defects (Bihari Chowdhary, Geeta Iron, Pioneer Builders); Sec 81-82 and Order XXVII including Rule 5B settlement; Sec 83 alien enemies; Sec 84-87B foreign States, Sec 86 consent and sovereign immunity (Mirza Ali Akbar Kashani, Ethiopian Airlines); Sec 91 public nuisance with leave; Sec 92 public charities and schemes (Swami Parmatmanand); Sec 88 and Order XXXV interpleader; Sec 75-78 commissions; Sec 94-95 supplemental proceedings and compensation

episodes.s: Bandhua Mukti Morcha — commissions Order XXVI and socio-legal commissions in PIL, minors Order XXXII, indigent persons Order XXXIII, Order XXII, Order XXIII
episodes.cover: Order XXVI commissions to examine witnesses, local investigation (Rule 9-10), scientific investigation 10A-10C, accounts, partition; socio-legal commissions in PIL (Bandhua Mukti Morcha, Sheela Barse, M.C. Mehta); Order XXXII next friend, guardian ad litem, Rule 7 compromise (Ram Chandra Arya), Rule 15; Order XXXIII indigent persons (Khader International), Rule 5 rejection, Rule 9; Order XXII death, abatement, Rule 9 (Perumon); Order XXIII withdrawal with liberty, Rule 3 compromise and Rule 3A (Pushpa Devi Bhagat)

episodes.s: Santosh Hazari — appeals Sec 96-112 and Order XLI, XLIII, XLV, reference, review and revision Sec 113-115, Art 227
episodes.cover: Right of appeal as a vested right (Garikapati); Sec 96-99A; Order XLI Rule 5 stay, Rule 11 summary dismissal, Rule 22 cross-objection, Rules 23-25 remand, Rule 27 additional evidence, Rule 31 judgment, Rule 33; Sec 100 substantial question of law (Chunilal Mehta, Santosh Hazari, Kondiba, Hero Vinoth), Sec 100A, 102, 103; Sec 104-106 and Order XLIII Rule 1; Sec 105; Sec 107-108; Sec 109 and Art 133; Sec 113 and Order XLVI reference; Sec 114 and Order XLVII review grounds; Sec 115 revision after 1999 (Shiv Shakti) and Art 227 (Surya Dev Rai, Radhey Shyam)

episodes.s: Katiji — Limitation Act 1963 Sec 3-27: bar, sufficient cause, legal disability, computation, acknowledgment, continuing wrongs, adverse possession
episodes.cover: Concept and rationale, lex fori, remedy vs right; Sec 3 mandatory bar and Sec 4; Sec 29(2) special laws; Sec 5 sufficient cause (Katiji, N. Balakrishnan, Basawaraj, Esha Bhattacharjee, Living Media) and its exclusion for suits and Order XXI; Sec 6-9 legal disability with the Sec 8 cap; Sec 12 time for copies; Sec 14 wrong court (Consolidated Engineering); Sec 15-16; Sec 17 fraud and mistake; Sec 18 acknowledgment essentials (Shapoor Freedom Mazda, Bishal Jaiswal) and Sec 19 payment; Sec 21-23 continuing wrongs; Sec 25-26 easements; Sec 27 extinguishment and adverse possession (Karnataka Wakf Board, Ravinder Kaur Grewal); principal Articles

episodes.s: Afcons Infrastructure — the 1976, 1999, 2002 and 2015 amendments, Sec 89 ADR, summary suits Order XXXVII, Mediation Act 2023, e-courts
episodes.cover: The 1976 amendment highlights; the 1999 and 2002 amendments and Salem Advocate (I) and (II); Sec 89 and Order X Rule 1A, the five modes, consent rule and suitability lists (Afcons); Lok Adalats and permanent Lok Adalats; Mediation Act 2023 and Sec 12A pre-institution mediation (Patil Automation); Order XXXVII summary suits and leave to defend (Mechelec, Hubtown); Commercial Courts Act 2015 — Order XIII-A summary judgment, Order XV-A case management, costs; time limits across the Code; e-filing, video conferencing (Swapnil Tripathi), NJDG and the reform agenda
